function_declarations.name: partnership_email_blast
function_declarations.description: Send per-partner email campaigns from a YAML roster through Resend, rendered via a clean HTML template. YAML is canonical; each partner gets one templated email with {{var}} substitution. Idempotent — re-runs skip partners already sent (unique index on campaign_id + partner_id WHERE ok=true). --dry-run by default, --apply sends, --prod required for live mode. Use when the user says "blast the partners", "fire the launch email", "email the partner list", "outreach campaign", or before a launch announcement.

apply.description: Actually send emails; default is dry-run.
